what_happened: All three repair parts were verified by compiled lean_run_code probes during research: the P-carrying stg_step/omega_chain port, the adapted PlusLCSchema call site (full lcN_plusValidInt re-proof), and the one-line backward LC_n corollary all elaborate with zero diagnostics, and #print axioms confirms the C14 profiles are unchanged ([propext, Quot.sound] for stg_step, pcq for omega_chain, pcq for the new corollary).

The landed omega_chain dropped three things from the probe's lines 681-688, not one: the segment-property parameter P, its stability hypothesis hP, AND the two further conclusions 'c 0 = s0' plus agreement with the start history below s0. The dispatch description names only P and hP. The dropped 'c 0 = s0' is load-bearing for LCU's consequent (it closes the coverage gap [t, c 0) in the G-less-or-equal), so research recommends restoring all of them in the same edit; the full-fidelity signature was verified to compile.

The research report deliberately omitted its five probe texts ('reconstructible from them... the implementation phase should re-elaborate rather than trust this summary'), so every Lean signature in the plan's Lean Challenge Statements block is a transcription from the report's prose rather than a re-measured artifact. Carried forward as an explicit re-elaboration obligation on Phase 1 and a top Risks row, not silently.

The research report did not cover the generated doc-sync surface at all. Running plan-file-scope-harvest.sh against the draft plan surfaced four companion paths the harvester augments for any .lean edit (typst/generated/status.typ plus three registered README inventory blocks), each gated by typst-sync-check.sh and check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory --check. Added to Phase 5 as explicit regeneration tasks, declared files, verification criteria, and two Risks rows.

lean-plan-compliance-check.sh harvests EVERY backticked token in the Goals block, not only the leading identifier that plan-format.md's Lean Challenge Statements section describes. Binder names cited in descriptive prose (P, hP) and cross-referenced existing lemmas (plusValidIn_reflectTime, lcN_plusValidZTime) were harvested as goal declarations, two of which can never resolve, so the Final Verification spot-check would have failed permanently. Fixed by removing all backticks from the Goals bullets' prose; harvested set now equals the Challenge Statements identifier set exactly.

Planning was nearly mechanical because the research phase verified every code change by compiled probe (including the whole of lcN_plusValidInt re-proved against the new omega_chain signature) and enumerated the record-surface obligations. Task 864's plan, which landed these same modules, supplied a directly reusable final-phase gate set and measure-then-paste C14 discipline. Both variants of the contested scope decision were pre-verified, so the narrow fallback is documented rather than speculative.
